scope: Same complete meeting source universe is fixed before any model call; no reference gold, selected answer IDs, reference query, task-specific extracted answer cells, review decisions or model scores enter raw inputs.
membership: Every physical Docs and Report file, every ordinary nested archive member; every readable whole DOCX and all XLSX worksheets and actual sparse rows. All source types/statuses and nonanswer rows remain included.
availability: Unsupported, failed and binary-only members remain in the physical inventory. Existing authenticated DOC text views may be reused only after exact original member/input hash plus converted-output hash checks; no new conversion.
word_view: All w:t, m:t, w:delText, field instruction text, tabs and breaks, without accepting/rejecting tracked changes. Symbol elements remain recorded; Symbol:F0DE uses the existing audited generic Unicode glyph mapping.
context_requirement: Root must make this fixed source universe eligible under the same source context policy for all compared methods and retain access/budget receipts. No task-specific positive-only source bundle.
legacy_runner_limitation: The unchanged existing runner gives A/B structural schema with database access and C/D bounded retrieval. Preparing this common raw universe does not establish identical prompts or source access across all four arms. Root must document representation/access differences or adapt the portable runner before claiming a common-source comparison.
retrieval_budget: Existing lexical algorithm and budgets remain unchanged when the shared augmentation builder is used; no outcome-driven source edits or quality retries.
